announcements.headline: Investor Presentation of Final Results
announcements.insight: As a key player in the UK asset management sector, Impax's final results presentation provides critical visibility into AUM flows and fee income trends amidst a volatile macro environment, signaling institutional confidence or caution regarding their long-term sustainable investing mandate.

announcements.headline: Notice of Results
announcements.insight: As a pure-play investment management firm, IPX's results are highly sensitive to AUM fluctuations and fee income; this notice signals the release of critical data on asset flows and performance relative to peers like Baillie Gifford or Fidelity.
